check_code:
import itertools
# regions over universe elements typed by membership in (C,P,L,M); enumerate models with small universes
types=list(itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4))
ok={'I':True,'II':True,'III':True}
found=False
for n in range(1,4):
  for model in itertools.product(types,repeat=n):
    C=lambda e:e[0];P=lambda e:e[1];L=lambda e:e[2];M=lambda e:e[3]
    if not any(C(e) for e in model): continue  # nonempty terms
    if not all(P(e) for e in model if C(e)): continue
    if not any(P(e) and L(e) for e in model): continue
    if not all(M(e) for e in model if L(e)): continue
    found=True
    ok['I']&=any(P(e) and C(e) for e in model)
    ok['II']&=any(L(e) and P(e) for e in model)
    ok['III']&=any(M(e) and L(e) for e in model)
assert found
res=frozenset(k for k,v in ok.items() if v)
opts={'A':frozenset({'II','III'}),'B':frozenset({'III'}),'C':frozenset({'I','III'}),'D':frozenset({'I','II','III'})}
assert res==opts['D']
assert all(res!=v for k,v in opts.items() if k!='D')

check_code:
import itertools
types=list(itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4)) # T,C,L,B
ok={'I':True,'II':True}
for n in range(1,4):
  for m in itertools.product(types,repeat=n):
    if not all(any(e[i] for e in m) for i in range(4)): continue
    if not any(e[0] and e[1] for e in m): continue
    if not all(e[2] for e in m if e[1]): continue
    if any(e[2] and e[3] for e in m): continue
    ok['I']&=all(e[0] for e in m if e[2])
    ok['II']&=not any(e[3] and e[2] for e in m)
res=frozenset(k for k,v in ok.items() if v)
opts={'A':frozenset({'II'}),'B':frozenset(),'C':frozenset({'I'}),'D':frozenset({'I','II'})}
assert res==opts['A'] and all(res!=v for k,v in opts.items() if k!='A')
